name: Mesmerized - An Intoxicated Story
source:
You have always been in love with your neighbor, the perfect and upright Mrs. Loveday.
But Mrs. Loveday wasn't always like that, she was once a sorority girl devoted to parties, men, and drinking.
Will you be able to awaken the party-girl?​
